slides.eyebrow: Here's a secret you wish you knew sooner
slides.sub: New in town? The farm dates to 1966, and it's 1 of 3 coffee stops on Chestnut and Broad.

slides.title: Rey Sol Coffee
slides.body: The family's coffee farm in Balboa, Colombia dates to 1966. The cafe says it roasts its beans right in the shop three times a week.
slides.source: OpenTable, Rey Sol listing (2026); ABC7 Localish (2021)

slides.title: Zen Haus Cafe
slides.body: A South Broad Street cafe with espresso, caramel lattes and savory bites. On Sunday it closes at 3 PM, so go early.
slides.source: Zen Haus Cafe ordering site, getsauce.com (Jun 2026)

slides.title: American Bulldog Coffee Roasters
slides.body: Its coffee is roasted in Chestnut Ridge, NY. The menu adds bakery items, soups and sandwiches.

slides.title: Ridgewood on foot
slides.tip: Start on Chestnut St, then walk Broad St from south to north. On a Sunday, get to Zen Haus before 3 PM.
